title: 拜年
setting: 11:40 pm, 除夕. Your desk. Twenty minutes to midnight, and it isn't too late.

xiaoge.name: 小葛
xiaoge.en: your assistant, at home with flour on her hands

liecheyuan.name: 列车员
liecheyuan.en: the guard on the last train

steps.narr: 11:40 pm. Your desk. The lamp is on, the lift is quiet, and on the window, fireworks. It isn't too late.
11:55. A door you saw only tonight, in a dream that wasn't. You knock, with a red envelope in your pocket.

steps.en: Boss?! What are you doing here?

say.en: Wish her a happy New Year.
say.tip: 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè = Happy New Year.

answers: 小葛，新年快乐！打扰你们了。
4.gloss: Happy New Year, 小葛! Sorry to barge in.

say.en: Give her the red envelope: this is for you.
say.gloss: This is for you. Thank you for all your work.
say.tip: 这个给你 = this is for you. Give and take a 红包 with both hands.

ok.narr: Inside the 红包: a bonus, and a note in your handwriting. Three days' extra holiday.

answers: 这个给你，这一年你辛苦了。
4.gloss: This is for you. You've worked so hard this year.

steps.narr: Midnight. Every firework in the city goes up at once. 弟弟 leans on his crutch and cheers the loudest.
12:20 am. The last train out of the city, nearly empty.
You call home from the train. It's picked up before the first ring has finished.

else.narr: 老妈 has stayed on the phone the whole way. So far she's said very little, and laughed twice.

steps.en: Happy New Year! Going home for the holiday?

say.en: Greet the guard back, and wish him prosperity.
say.gloss: Happy New Year! May you prosper!
say.tip: 恭喜发财 gōngxǐ fācái = may you prosper: the cheerful New Year greeting.

ok.en: And you! Home's the place to be.

answers: 新年好！过年还上班，恭喜发财！
4.gloss: Happy New Year! Working on New Year's: may you prosper!

steps.narr: Dawn. The first morning of the year. Your parents' door. Before you can knock, it opens.
Behind her, on the table: three bowls. Three pairs of chopsticks.

steps.en: The bowl's been there all along.

say.en: Apologise: sorry, I'm back so late.
say.gloss: I'm sorry. I'm back so late.
say.tip: 回来晚了 = came back late: 晚 + 了.

answers: 爸妈，对不起，我回来晚了。
4.gloss: Mum, Dad, I'm sorry. I'm back so late.

say.en: Wish them good health for the year.
say.tip: 身体健康 = good health: the 拜年 wish for parents and grandparents.

ok.en: Come in, the dumplings are getting cold.

answers: 祝你们身体健康，万事如意！
4.gloss: Wishing you good health, and everything you hope for!

steps.narr: The table. 老爸 drops a dumpling into your bowl, not at all secretly. You bite into a coin.

say.en: Tell them you're home, or promise: every year from now on.
say.tip: 我回来了 = I'm back: what you say coming through the door.

ok.narr: She says it again, quietly, to herself, as if checking it's true.

alts.en: Or: every year from now on
alts.gloss: From now on, I'll come home every year.

answers: 我回来了，这次多住几天。
4.gloss: I'm home. And this time I'm staying a few days.

answers: 我保证，以后每年我都回来。
alts.gloss: I promise: from now on, I'll come home every year.

steps.en: New Year's morning. Three bowls, a coin in yours, and nowhere else you need to be. Season over. 新年快乐. 🧧

else.en: New Year's morning. 老爸 circles next year's 除夕 on the calendar, in red, twice. Season over. 新年快乐. 🧧
